scope: Existing Log UDP ingest and single/bulk transaction outcomes; synthetic native PostgreSQL fixture, not complete production Log migration

protocol.source_behavior: CUdpSocket::ReadPacket requeues if disconnected; LogDBSave builds date-partitioned INSERT and writes 512 blob bytes.
protocol.independent_fixture: Explicit Win32 original header 36 bytes; LogData prefix 500 bytes, not imported from the modern encoder.

modern_correction.committed: Only acknowledged COMMIT increments Inserts or DrainedAfterRetry.
modern_correction.retryable: Pool acquisition timeout, failure before any INSERT during BEGIN, or acknowledged ROLLBACK after an INSERT failure.
modern_correction.unknown: Any COMMIT exception or unconfirmed rollback closes the connection, increments UnknownOutcomes by record count, logs a fixed error and never requeues the affected record/batch. Even a negative COMMIT reply is conservatively unknown.
modern_correction.connection: The shared pool has no automatic closed-session replacement; process/pool replacement remains necessary.
modern_correction.batch: One parameterized INSERT and transaction; at most 72 rows (2016 parameters) per drain. A serialization mutex covers new writes and drained-batch restoration.
modern_correction.binary: Nonempty native PostgreSQL payload is bound as hexadecimal bytea text, preserving all bytes including NUL. Empty remains NULL. Full DWORD/WORD values use widened bind storage.
modern_correction.worker: Periodic drain uses configured worker pool and one scheduling guard. Graceful shutdown joins worker jobs without first dropping queued jobs.

verification.unit: test_tlogsvr_audit_transaction: 20 assertions, including failures at begin/insert/rollback/commit/close for single and batch.

native_per_configuration.fault: Loopback PostgreSQL proxy drops CommandComplete COMMIT only after PostgreSQL executed it; both single and bulk remain persisted once after repeated drains. INSERT reply-loss separately exercises unconfirmed rollback.
native_per_configuration.concurrency: Concurrent failed writes/drains preserve bounded queue; confirmed rollback retains a complete rejected batch; joining workers completes 32 accepted jobs.
native_per_configuration.daemon: Original-layout UDP to actual native persisted fields, malformed datagram, binary/null payloads, confirmed rollback retry, health during pg_sleep in periodic drain and SIGTERM.
native_per_configuration.release_limit: Installed Release UDP daemon; backend C++ executable remains the verified Debug build.

verification.harness_correction: Initial installed daemon test could not read its private configuration. Final runner maps the host owner to container UID/GID 10001 and retains private configuration permissions; repeated Release run passed.
